summary: Customer runs an aqueous cell culture process and currently measures glucose and lactate from samples, which is too slow to see changes promptly. They want to explore an in situ spectroscopy pilot, checked against their existing laboratory measurements. No probe, calibration strategy, measurement ranges or process conditions are specified.
